    Class TpTextfield

    Single-line and automatically growing multiline text field.

    Example

    <tp-textfield label="Single line" placeholder="Type some text..." clearable></tp-textfield>

        <tp-textfield label="Multiline" multiline placeholder="Type some text..." clearable value="An example of text that has already been entered in the field"></tp-textfield>

    Tagname

    tp-textfield

    Attr

    type = "text" - Input type (text, email, password, search, tel, or url).

    Attr

    multiline = false - Uses an automatically growing textarea instead of an input.

    Attr

    label = "" - Visible label associated with the native input or textarea.

    Attr

    label-position = "top" - Label position (top, bottom, start, or end).

    Attr

    value = "" - Current field value.

    Attr

    name = "" - Name submitted with the containing form; defaults to the initial inline content when omitted.

    Attr

    placeholder = "" - Placeholder shown while the field is empty.

    Attr

    autocomplete = "" - Native autocomplete hint.

    Attr

    rows = 3 - Minimum number of rows in multiline mode.

    Attr

    required = false - Marks the field as required.

    Attr

    readonly = false - Prevents value editing.

    Attr

    disabled = false - Disables the field and its clear button.

    Attr

    clearable = false - Shows the clear button; it is disabled when empty, readonly or disabled.

    Attr

    icon = "" - Prefix icon name.

    Attr

    icon-library = "tp" - Prefix icon library. input Emitted when the value changes while editing. change Emitted when the edited value is committed. tp-clear Emitted after the embedded button clears the value.

    Cssprop

    [--tp-textfield-background=var(--tp-paper-color)] Field background.

    Cssprop

    [--tp-textfield-border-color=var(--tp-neutral-stroke-soft)] Field border color.

    Cssprop

    [--tp-textfield-focus-color=var(--tp-brand-text-colorful)] Focus border color.

    Cssprop

    [--tp-textfield-inline-size=20ch] Width of a single-line text field.

    Cssprop

    [--tp-textfield-label-gap=0.35em] Space between the label and its field.

    Cssprop

    [--tp-textfield-label-font-weight=500] Label font weight.

    Cssprop

    [--tp-textfield-radius=var(--tp-border-radius-sm)] Field border radius.

    Cssprop

    [--tp-textfield-required-color=var(--tp-danger-text-colorful)] Required marker color.

    Cssprop

    [--tp-textfield-padding-block=0.6em] Vertical field padding.

    Cssprop

    [--tp-textfield-padding-inline=0.75em] Horizontal field padding.

    Cssprop

    [--tp-textfield-value-font-weight=400] Entered value and placeholder font weight.
